name: trevoros-v2
description: Trevor's personal operating system: AM/PM check-ins, PKM capture, OCR, transcript processing, and Second Brain growth powered by LLMs, Make, Google Sheets, GitHub, and Markdown.
author: Trevor + AI Assistants

scripts.am-checkin: Initiate AM check-in flow, return JSON + Markdown
scripts.pm-checkin: Initiate PM reflection flow, return JSON + Markdown
scripts.capture: Ingest arbitrary content (text/link/image) and classify it
scripts.route: Decide where a capture should go (Sheets | Logs | PKM | Inbox)
scripts.summarize: Summarize content into PKM-ready structured output
scripts.ocr: Extract and process text from images/screenshots
scripts.edge-coach: Provide reflection and planning using the EDGE framework
scripts.append-log: Append Markdown entries to GitHub logs

dependencies.make.com: Webhook → routing → GitHub → Sheets automation engine.
dependencies.google-sheets: Structured AM/PM timeline and task log.
dependencies.github-api: Append log entries and create PKM notes in repo.
dependencies.ocr-service: Built-in iOS OCR or external API for screenshots.
dependencies.llm-runtime: Base44, ChatGPT, or other LLM platforms.
